title: Knee pain
claims: NHS knee pain guidance advises icing for up to 20 minutes every 2 to 3 hours and avoiding prolonged standing.
NHS lists urgent signs: very painful knee, inability to move or bear weight, badly swollen or changed shape, locking, giving way or painful clicking, or fever with redness and heat around the knee.
NHS advises seeing a GP if knee pain does not improve within a few weeks.
